quest.title: Temple Inquiry
quest.description: Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Are you fully girded up, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here comes one of those spirits...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: My name is...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Aberaku, Helios-Forger!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: How could I have been felled by your vile slander, or imprisoned by your puppet infants!?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: I— No, wait. I was imprisoned for months and years beyond count, was I not? Then... This must be my post-life form?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Post-life form"? You mean that you're already dead, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Takes a pretty rare spirit to realize that.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: And yet, though it shames me to say so, I know not just how I died...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: But I recall that I was imprisoned on orders from a child.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A child?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Indeed. But till today, I can never feel any hatred for that child, only pity.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: He was not at fault. The blame should fall upon those who controlled him like a puppet in their palms... Forget it. Such things are best left unsaid.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: After that, I was imprisoned...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Imprisoned in a...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In a...?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: In a very high place.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: But though it was high up, it was dark, lightless, and cold as the ice itself.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: ...Strange. Why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Why do I feel that a high place should have brought a person warmth and comfort?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Why... Why can't I remember any of this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you hungry, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whenever Paimon's famished, forget thinking, she can barely even talk straight!

choices.text: I don't think that's his issue...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, it's gotta be! Look at him, he can hardly speak clearly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Actually, {NICKNAME}, could you check if there's something to eat amongst the offerings?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What, do you wanna eat them?

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: When I died in prison, my attire and body were enshrined in various places due to my contribution in creating the Helios.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: But that also caused my spirit to be separated and rendered unable to rest.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: This place should have been the resting place of my sacred crown, though it has surely decayed by now. This must surely be why my thoughts are so... stuck.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: If this persists, I doubt that even my current state can be sustained for long...

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: But these offerings can be used to replace the remnants of my body and my attire in sustaining an ounce of my thoughts.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: As such, please take them with you.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: However, there are many perils on the enshrining path. So though it may seem rude of me, could you accept a certain test first?

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: Please defeat the monsters hereabouts, the prison wardens of my spirit.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: This matter is perilous. Tell me once you are ready, O Traveler, and we shall begin.

choices.text: Well, it just so happens that we have some emergen—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Then I wish you... every success in your battle ahead.

talks.objective: Obtain the offerings from the spirit

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Ah, if only Byakuyakoku had such valiant warriors as you! Then...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: *sigh* If this thing is done, then my wishes shall be fulfilled.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: You must bring these offerings bearing my thoughts to be enshrined... in the place where I was held under arrest. We must do this, in order to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In order to what?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: In order to... In order to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, there's no use talking to this guy now. Seems like his spirit's all messed up again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's just take those items with us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where was this high-up place where this guy was imprisoned?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need a while more to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Then I shall await your tidings.
